# Solar Consumer Research

> A source-verified directory of public resources and procedural guides for residential solar consumers. Massachusetts is the first covered state.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://solar-resource-mvp.rbeland21.chatgpt.site/
- Resources: https://solar-resource-mvp.rbeland21.chatgpt.site/resources
- Guides: https://solar-resource-mvp.rbeland21.chatgpt.site/guides
- Updates: https://solar-resource-mvp.rbeland21.chatgpt.site/updates
- Methodology: https://solar-resource-mvp.rbeland21.chatgpt.site/methodology
- Disclaimer: https://solar-resource-mvp.rbeland21.chatgpt.site/disclaimer

## Source and citation policy

- External resources identify the publisher, source type, and last verification date.
- Government agencies and regulators are distinguished from private nonprofit organizations.
- Summaries are general public information and should not be treated as legal advice, claim evaluation, or a finding of wrongdoing.
- When citing a listed resource, prefer the linked original publisher page.

## Current coverage

- Federal consumer, finance, and complaint resources
- Massachusetts consumer protection, utility, public-record, and solar-program resources
- Independent organizations, clearly labeled by role
- Source-based preparation guides on a separate Guides page
- Local and municipal information is coming soon
